Card Q&A.a: No. If you have 4 or more cards in your security stack, you gain 1 memory. But you can only gain 1 memory from this effect.
Card Q&A.q: On attack, if I have 8 cards in my security stack, does this card's inherited effect cause me to gain 2 memory?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have 4 or more security cards, gain 1 memory.
